page.title: Import customers and leads
page.description: Bring your customers and open leads over from a spreadsheet. Duplicates (same phone, then same email) are updated, never added twice.

type_help.customers: Columns: first_name, last_name, phone, email, address, sales_rep_email, sms_consent, email_consent, consent_source, notes. A yes in sms_consent or email_consent records consent with source import.
type_help.leads: Columns: first_name, last_name, phone, email, source, vehicle_interest, received_at, sales_rep_email, notes. Each row opens a lead and its deal; without a known rep it goes to round robin.
